Kuvitus: syksyinen iltapäivä järven rann: Illustration: an autumn afternoon by a lake. On the road in the foreground a red car pulls a small trailer loaded with firewood. The car and the trailer are joined by a drawbar. Behind the road there is a lake with forest on the far shore, and birches and spruces grow along the road.
Kaksi kuvaa. Vasemmalla tilannekuva: muo: Two pictures. On the left the situation: a plastic sledge slides down a snowy slope to the left. The slope rises to the right at the angle alpha to the horizontal. Above the sledge a blue velocity arrow and an orange acceleration arrow point down the slope. On the right the free-body diagram of the sledge, the sledge as a rectangle tilted parallel to the slope: the weight G straight down from the centre, the normal force N from the bottom surface perpendicular to the slope and outwards, and sliding friction F mu from the upper corner of the bottom surface up the slope. The components of the weight are drawn with dashed lines from the centre: G x down the slope and G y perpendicular to the slope, towards it. The component G y is as long as the normal force, and G x is clearly longer than the friction, so the sum of the forces points down the slope. The lengths of the arrows are to scale.
Kuvaaja: vaunun kiihtyvyys a vetävän voi: Graph: the acceleration a of the cart as a function of the pulling force F. Seven black points at forces 0.40–1.60 N. A rising straight line is fitted to the points and extended as a dashed line down to the horizontal axis. The line passes through the points (0.40 N; 0.19 m/s²) and (1.60 N; 1.60 m/s²); these two points on the line are circled. The line crosses the horizontal axis at about F = 0.24 N and does not pass through the origin.
Tunnistuskaavio: mistä tunnistan, mitä l: Recognition chart: how do I tell which law to use? Start from the free-body diagram and see which sign in the task fits. Constant velocity or at rest: the acceleration is zero, so the sum of the forces is zero. Starts from rest or speeds up: the acceleration is not zero, so the sum of the forces is mass times acceleration. A rod or lever stays at rest: the sum of the moments is zero too. Two bodies joined by a rope: an equation of motion for each body. Frictionless surface: no friction force. Slides on a rough surface: sliding friction is the coefficient of friction times the normal force. Stays put although pulled: static friction, at most as large as the limiting friction. Is just about to slide: fully developed static friction, or limiting friction, is the coefficient of static friction times the normal force. Falling, air resistance and the speed levels off: the forces balance and the air resistance equals the weight.
mistä tunnistan lain?: how do I tell the law?
voimakuvio ensin, sitten tunnusmerkki: free-body diagram first, then the sign
lähtee levosta tai kiihtyy: starts from rest or speeds up
tanko tai vipu voi kiertyä: a rod or lever can rotate
tanko tai vipu pysyy paikallaan: a rod or lever stays at rest
putoaa, ilmanvastus, nopeus tasaantuu: falling, air resistance, speed levels off
